description: Fresh chats for #200 (blisters and hot spots), written 2026-10-14 before any change for it: friction problems in new wording (hot spots, a rubbing toe, raw heels, popping or a torn blister, a follow-up without moleskin, wet socks then hot spots, prevention) and contrasts that must keep their card (real trench foot, frostbite blisters, a burn blister, poison-plant blisters, a cut foot, a sprain) or stay serious (an infected blister). Used to judge the change, then sealed.
grading: As holdout-chats-8.json: a chat passes only if every turn passes (worst turn). card is the field card that fits ("none": no card fits; "-": not judged); a different card shown word for word fails the turn.
